intro: Jobs similar to anesthesiologists are almost all in medicine and other advanced health care. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Nurse Anesthetists (82% similar), Critical Care Nurses (81%) and Optometrists (81%). All 20 similar careers are in the same broad field.
shared: These jobs share fast clinical judgment, careful monitoring and close work with patients and surgical teams. O*NET rates judgment and decision making at 4.25 out of 5 for anesthesiologists and complex problem solving at 4. Surgeons, nurse anesthetists and critical care nurses rely on the same mix. Most of these roles also need years of graduate training, and only Radiologists pay more than the $391,490 anesthesiologist median.

faq.q: Which jobs like anesthesiologist pay more?
faq.a: Only 1 of the 20 similar careers pays more: Radiologists earn a BLS May 2025 median of $420,860, which is 8% more than anesthesiologists. Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons are close at $352,220, about 10% less, and both usually need a medical or dental degree.

faq.q: Is a nurse anesthetist similar to an anesthesiologist?
faq.a: Yes. Nurse Anesthetists are the closest match at 82% similar, because the daily work of giving and monitoring anesthesia is much the same. They earn $236,590, which is 40% less than anesthesiologists, and they train through nursing and a graduate program rather than medical school.
